notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Corrections :

 The words "new" no longer appear on merchant runes
 The Mercenary#2 no longer has a "hit" animation when taking wound damage


Balance :

 Rune CONTROL : "Cumulative aura" increased amount of aura (6->7)
 Rune BLOOD : "Resonant attack" increased damage (25% -> 30 %)
 Ability CONTROL : "Safe materialization" increased aura gain (10 -> 12)
 Ability CONTROL : "Safe materialization" cost reduction (5 -> 4)
 Talent NATURE : +1 wound when a wound is applied -> (+3 wound)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes :


 Fixed crash caused by Mystic endchain action and game speed at 400%
 The “activation” ability correctly triggers BRAVE talents #1 and #2
 It is no longer possible to place runes on locked chain slots (specific case with a full hand and a rune that cannot be placed in the last position)
 Mobs' attack speed now matches game speed (useful for 400%)
 Mobs are correctly replaced after using the “temporality” rune if a mob has been destroyed.
 Fix “Presence” passive mob, which now correctly considers physical and magical damage


Additions :

 In-game display of a “new” mention under runes/abilities/talents that are not in your library (that you've never chosen before)
 The “Ctrl” shortcut to disable/enable damage preview is now active only in battle or in options. This will limit the number of times this key is pressed by mistake, leaving players without a preview, and unaware that the option has been disabled.
 The 1st chain slot will always be the last to be locked (offers more playability, especially with runes that exhaust the next slot's rune)
 Visual update of some achievements (on STEAM)


Balance

 BLOOD rune : "Runic wound" increased number of wounds per rune in hand (3 -> 4)
 MYSTIC rune : "Runic shock" increased damage (30 -> 40)
 CONTROL rune : "Runic aura" increased number of auras per rune in hand (3 -> 4)


 BRAVE ability : "Breaking" cost reduction (6 -> 5)


 Mob : Archer Gormnoq Reduced HP (145 -> 140)
(Allows more early game combos to destroy it in 1 turn, especially on room 2)
